<untrusted-project-content path="app/v2.css" etag="1790576829530665">
/* app/v2.css — Fightlytics v2 scroll story */
:root{--x-bg:#000;--x-panel:#0e0f12;--x-panel-2:#15171b;--x-ink:#f5f5f4;--x-mute:#9a9892;--x-dim:#5c5a56;--x-line:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
body{background:var(--x-bg);color:var(--x-ink)}
a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}a:hover{color:#ff6a40}
.x-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
.x-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}
.x-center{display:grid;place-items:center}
.x-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--accent)}
.x-h1,.x-h2,.x-final-h{font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--x-ink);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
.x-h1{font-size:clamp(44px,min(9.4vw,13vh),136px);line-height:.92}
.x-h2{font-size:clamp(34px,min(5.6vw,9vh),80px);line-height:.98}
.x-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:44px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-on);font:700 15px 'Manrope',sans-serif;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.x-pill:hover{background:#ff6a40;color:var(--accent-on)}
.x-pill:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.x-pill.sm{height:30px;padding:0 14px;font-size:12.5px}
.x-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:var(--accent)}
.x-link .material-symbols-outlined{font-size:18px;transition:transform .2s}
.x-link:hover .material-symbols-outlined{transform:translateX(3px)}

/* nav */
.x-nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:50;height:52px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--x-line)}
.x-nav-in{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}
.x-nav-brand{display:flex}
.x-nav-links{display:flex;gap:28px}
.x-nav-links a{color:var(--x-mute);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.x-nav-links a:hover{color:var(--x-ink)}

/* hero */
.x-hero{height:260vh;position:relative}
.x-hero .x-sticky{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.x-hero-copy{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(52px + 7vh);text-align:center;padding:0 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:min(22px,2.8vh);opacity:calc(1 - var(--p,0)*3.6);transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0)*-90px)) scale(calc(1 - var(--p,0)*.1));will-change:transform,opacity}
.x-hero.past .x-hero-copy{pointer-events:none}
.x-hero-sub{margin:0;font-size:clamp(19px,1.9vw,26px);font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.x-rot{display:inline-block;color:var(--x-ink);min-width:6.6em;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:bottom;height:1.3em}
.x-rot span{display:inline-block;animation:x-rot-in .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes x-rot-in{from{transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.x-hero-ctas{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.x-hero-media{--q:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .04)*1.75),1);position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(1180px,92vw);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--q))*var(--x-drop,56vh))) scale(calc(.78 + var(--q)*.22));transform-origin:50% 0;will-change:transform}
.x-hero-media .mockup{box-shadow:0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}

/* statement */
.x-statement{height:230vh}
.x-state-p{max-width:1040px;margin:0;padding:0 28px;font:800 clamp(32px,4.7vw,66px)/1.1 'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-wrap:pretty}
.x-state-p span{opacity:clamp(.14,calc(var(--p,0)*var(--n)*1.3 - var(--i)),1);color:var(--x-ink);transition:opacity .1s linear}
.x-state-p span.hot{color:var(--accent)}

/* stats reel */
.x-reel{height:420vh;background:linear-gradient(#000,#0a0a0b 20%,#0a0a0b 80%,#000)}
.x-reel .x-sticky{display:flex;align-items:center}
.x-reel-grid{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:48px;align-items:center}
.x-reel-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.x-reel-rail{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.x-reel-rail li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--x-dim);transition:color .3s}
.x-reel-rail li.on{color:var(--x-ink)}
.x-reel-rail li.done{color:var(--x-mute)}
.x-reel-rail .bar{width:44px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);overflow:hidden;flex:none}
.x-reel-rail .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--accent)}
.x-reel-rail li.done .bar i{width:100%;background:var(--x-mute)}
.x-reel-rail li.on .bar i{width:calc(var(--local,0)*100%)}
.x-reel-stat{animation:x-stat-in .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes x-stat-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.x-reel-pre{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);font-weight:700;color:var(--x-mute);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.x-reel-num{font:800 clamp(120px,19vw,272px)/.86 'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.065em;color:var(--x-ink);margin:6px 0 18px;white-space:nowrap}
.x-reel-num small{font-size:.34em;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--accent);margin-left:.08em}
.x-reel-label{font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,34px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--x-ink)}
.x-reel-note{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--x-mute);max-width:32ch}

/* gallery */
.x-gallery{height:340vh;overflow:clip}
.x-gal-stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:min(40px,4vh);padding:52px 0 16px}
.x-gal-head{width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.x-gal-viewport{width:100%;overflow:visible}
.x-gal-track{display:flex;gap:24px;padding:0 max(28px,calc((100vw - 1180px)/2 + 28px));width:max-content;will-change:transform}
.x-card{width:min(520px,80vw);height:min(520px,max(300px,calc(100vh - 52px - 16px - 8vh - var(--x-head,140px) - 8px - 30px)));border-radius:28px;background:var(--x-panel);border:1px solid var(--x-line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .4s,background .4s}
.x-card.on{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:var(--x-panel-2)}
.x-card-copy{padding:min(32px,4vh) 32px 0}
.x-card-k{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px}
.x-card h3{margin:0;font:800 clamp(24px,2.3vw,32px)/1.12 'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--x-ink);text-wrap:balance}
.x-vis{margin:min(24px,3vh) 24px;flex:1;min-height:0;border-radius:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.x-vis-video{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 90%,rgba(255,77,28,.08),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(#15171b,#0b0c0e)}
.x-vis-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;padding:4px}
.x-vis-tl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:14px;padding:0 6px}
.x-tl-rounds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--x-dim)}
.x-tl-track{position:relative;height:64px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--x-line);background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent calc(33.33% - 1px),var(--x-line) calc(33.33% - 1px),var(--x-line) 33.33%,transparent 33.33%,transparent calc(66.66% - 1px),var(--x-line) calc(66.66% - 1px),var(--x-line) 66.66%,transparent 66.66%)}
.x-tl-track i{position:absolute;top:14px;bottom:14px;width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent)}
.x-tl-track i.k{background:#ffb199}
.x-tl-track i.g{top:22px;bottom:22px;background:rgba(255,112,67,.35);border-radius:4px}
.x-tl-head{position:absolute;top:-6px;bottom:-6px;width:2px;background:var(--x-ink)}
.x-tl-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute)}
.x-tl-legend span::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:6px;background:var(--accent)}
.x-tl-legend .k::before{background:#ffb199}.x-tl-legend .g::before{background:rgba(255,112,67,.45)}
.x-vis-rep{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-evenly;gap:8px;padding:0 6px;min-height:150px}
.x-rep-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:6px}
.x-rep-top span{font-size:clamp(18px,3vh,26px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--x-ink)}
.x-rep-top em{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute)}
.x-rep-bar{height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(96,165,250,.45);overflow:hidden}
.x-rep-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.x-gal-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.x-gal-dots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);transition:width .35s,background .35s}
.x-gal-dots i.on{width:28px;background:var(--x-ink)}

/* duo */
.x-duo{padding:160px 0 120px}
.x-duo-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:72px}
.x-duo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px}
.x-duo-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:56px 36px 20px;border-radius:28px;background:var(--x-panel);border:1px solid var(--x-line)}
.x-duo-mark{color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:26px}
.x-duo-mark.alt{padding:10px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,77,28,.35)}
.x-duo-mark:not(.alt){padding:10px}
.x-duo-name{font:800 clamp(30px,3vw,42px)/1 'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--x-ink)}
.x-duo-name span{font-family:var(--display-font);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--x-mute);font-size:.8em}
.x-duo-who{margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute)}
.x-duo-line{margin:22px 0 26px;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--x-ink);text-wrap:balance}
.x-duo-specs{margin:44px 0 0;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.x-duo-specs div{padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--x-line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.x-duo-specs dt{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-mute)}
.x-duo-specs dd{margin:0;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--x-ink)}

/* final */
.x-final{height:170vh}
.x-final-in{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:24px;padding:0 24px;opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--p,0)*3),1);transform:scale(calc(.9 + clamp(0,calc(var(--p,0)*2),1)*.1))}
.x-final-h{font-size:clamp(48px,7.6vw,112px);line-height:.95}
.x-final-h span{color:var(--accent)}
.x-final-p{margin:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--x-mute);font-weight:600}
.x-signup{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}
.x-signup input{height:44px;width:280px;max-width:80vw;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--x-line);background:var(--x-panel);color:var(--x-ink);font:500 15px 'Manrope',sans-serif;outline:none}
.x-signup input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.x-final-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--x-dim);font-weight:600}
.x-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--x-line);padding:28px 0}
.x-foot-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--x-dim)}
.x-foot-links{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:22px}
.x-foot-links a{color:var(--x-mute)}.x-foot-links a:hover{color:var(--x-ink)}

@media (max-width:860px){
.x-nav-links{display:none}
.x-reel-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
.x-reel-rail{flex-direction:row;gap:8px}
.x-reel-rail li{font-size:0;gap:0}
.x-reel-rail .bar{width:100%;min-width:40px}
.x-reel-rail li{flex:1}
.x-duo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}

I've implemented the "Fightlytics Landing v2" design from Claude Design into `landing/`:

- `landing/index.html` — replaces the "Hello World" placeholder with the real page shell (fonts, favicon, React/Babel CDN scripts)
- `landing/app/logo.jsx`, `landing/app/mockup.jsx`, `landing/app/v2.jsx` — the glove logo, analysis-player mockup, and the scroll-driven product story (hero → statement → stats reel → capability gallery → Studio/Broadcast comparison → final CTA)
- `landing/app/styles.css`, `landing/app/sections.css`, `landing/app/v2.css` — the full styling stack these components depend on
- Removed the now-unused placeholder `landing/style.css`

I verified all files serve correctly over a local HTTP server (200s on the page, JSX, and CSS). Note: I don't have a browser/screenshot tool in this environment, so I could not visually render it — only confirmed the files are byte-for-byte faithful to the Claude Design source and serve without 404s. I'd recommend opening `landing/index.html` in a browser yourself to sanity-check the scroll animations before shipping.

Two things worth flagging:
- The nav/footer/"Broadcast" card link to `Fightlytics Broadcast.html`, which wasn't part of this task's scope — that link will 404 locally until that page is implemented too.
- The "Studio" CTA points to `https://app.fightlytics.com` as authored in the design.

That's expected with `file://` — Babel's `<script type="text/babel" src="...">` does an XHR fetch to load the JSX, which browsers block under the `file:` origin. It needs to be served over `http://` instead. This isn't a bug in the page, just a limitation of opening it directly by double-clicking.

Run a local server from the `landing/` directory and open it via `http://localhost`:
